content.text:
Avi, I'm checking with you before I do anything, but I think it's **Clal (כלל)**. It's the cheapest one I found: 0.48% a year, taken from the money saved. I'm fairly sure, because the page says the cheapest is 0.48%, and that's the number I found on Clal at the bottom of the list. Menora (מנורה מבטחים) was almost the same at 0.49%.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. **The top of the page.** It says "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" (all the plans at all the companies) and that the numbers come from the official market authority ("רשות שוק ההון"). That calmed me a little.
2. **The buttons.** "קרן השתלמות 154" and "עוקב S&P 500 12" were already lit up. The S&P letters were in my task, so I read them. Most of the other buttons I skipped.
3. **The sentence under the buttons.** "12 מסלולים של 12 חברות … דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.48% עד 0.7%" means 12 plans from 12 companies, with fees from 0.48% to 0.7%. Then: "מסודרים לפי דמי הניהול מהחיסכון, מהיקר לזול" means sorted from the most expensive to the cheapest. So the cheapest is at the bottom, and I had to scroll the whole list to get there.
4. **The list.** I only read the right-hand side: the company name and the fee number. Mor 0.7% at the top, then down to Harel and Migdal at 0.5% each, Menora 0.49%, and Clal 0.48%.
5. **The last line, Ayalon (איילון קופות גמל).** It says "עוד לא דווח" (not reported yet) where the fee should be, and has a small "חדש" (new) mark. I don't know what they charge, so I left it out. Its money is also only partly in shares (40%), so I don't think it's the same thing.

**What I skipped:** the circles, the "מט"ח" column and its percentages, the returns over 3 and 5 years, and the "כסף מנוהל" numbers (money managed). I also skipped the small grey lines at the bottom and the "חוקים וכללים" button.

**What I didn't understand:**
- "מט"ח 100%" and "101%". How can it be more than 100%?
- The coloured circles.
- "אין מההפקדות" ("none from deposits"). I think it means they take nothing from what you put in, but I'm not sure.
- "PF-06".
- "קופה" with a number like 13342.
- "עוקב S&P 500": I'm not sure every company on the list really follows it. Only Altshuler and Analyst say so under their names.

**What bothered me:**
- It's white and grey writing on black, and the grey text was hard to read even enlarged.
- Every line repeats "מהחיסכון", "אין מההפקדות" and the circle, so each time I had to read through all of it just to find the one number that changes.
- It's sorted from expensive to cheap, so I had to go all the way to the bottom.
- At the very bottom it says "אתר אישי, לא מסחרי" (a personal, non-commercial site). It isn't the bank or anything official, so I wouldn't act on it without you or the bank.
- Two screens was enough. By the end I was tired.
